Opportunity.title: Opportunity
Opportunity.description: Verified university and study opportunity record containing official URLs, verification citations, and eligibility rules.

sourceUrl.description: Primary verified admissions or scholarship bulletin source URL

isVerified.description: Whether this record is verified against official registry

verificationSource.description: Official authority and citation verifying this listing

verifiedAt.description: Academic cycle or date of verification

eligibilityCountries.description: List of countries or regions eligible for this opportunity

fundingDetails.description: Structured details on tuition coverage and living allowances

applicationFees.description: Application fee status, amount, and waiver instructions

testWaiverRules.description: SAT/ACT and English language waiver policies

deadlines.description: Term and verified deadline date or rolling notice

studyFields.description: Eligible fields of study and academic majors

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private student account profile with academic preferences, saved opportunities, and application tracker.

profile.description: Academic onboarding profile including nationality, degree goal, and study destinations

savedOpportunities.description: List of bookmarked opportunity IDs in student's Saved Opportunities

targetList.description: Map of opportunity IDs to future study goal metadata (priority, intakeYear, personalGoal)

activeApplications.description: Map of opportunity IDs to started application progress, stage, and task checklists

applicationTracker.description: Legacy mapping of opportunity IDs to application progress stages

scholarshipAlerts.description: Scholarship alert subscription preferences and status for this student

CovaConversation.title: CovaConversation
CovaConversation.description: Private COVA AI advisor conversation thread scoped to an authenticated student account.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of last message or rename

messages.description: Ordered list of conversation messages with compact opportunity ID references

/opportunities/{opportunityId}.description: Public directory of verified real university programs and scholarships.

/users/{userId}.description: Private student user account and academic profile data.

/users/{userId}/covaConversations/{conve.description: Private COVA AI assistant conversation threads owned by the authenticated student.
